coreIdea: Draw the call tree, resolve base cases first, propagate values back up. Before-recursive-call code prints forward; after-call code prints reversed.
mustRememberFormulas: Doubling recursion (2 self-calls): T(n)=2T(n-1)+1 → exponential ~2^n calls
Static/global vars inside recursion are SHARED across all calls, not per-call copies

commonTrapsQuickList: static/global inside recursion = ONE shared value, not fresh per call
Code after the recursive call prints in REVERSE order

highYieldPyqLessons: Basic value-tracing (8/19) is the default skill — get the call-tree habit automatic.
